Qui potiùs quàm admitteret huius orationis Parænetica (licèt elegantis & politæ) authorem fuisse Romanū Pontificem, maluit Ecclesiam Constantinopolitanam κατ᾽ ἐξοχὴν[?] Magnam appellari. Sed in his tricis diutiùs immorari non licet, digitum tantum ad horum hominū impostūras et strophas intendo, et ad Iustinianū redeo, ut versus senectutem inNiceph.{u} Apththar-

page.notes: Underlining under "Qui" and a stroke under "Romanum"/"maluit" are printed marks, not text. Greek "κατ᾽ ἐξοχὴν" is blurred; accents uncertain. Faint ghost lines in the right margin are show-through and are left out. Marginal note "Niceph." is printed as far as it shows at the foot of the scan. The left-hand strip shows only the right-hand ends of lines of the left printed page; these are fragments, and their words cannot be completed. The reading "todocitarum" in italic is uncertain. The right margin note "l.17.c.31." is a bare reference placed at the top of the column.
